decisions.reason: The air quality sensor remains central to the environmental sensing line and its dedicated page reflects sunk investment and public commitment.
As the third-generation core analog input module, its established customer base and accumulated investment make withdrawal improbable.
The MQTT proxy is central to the announced software and connectivity direction, and its public commitment discourages dropping.
The CO2 sensor is a visible part of the environmental sensing platform, so prior investment and platform fit justify persistence.
Although the touch panel accessory is less central, its public presentation and contribution to platform usability create enough commitment to keep it.
